author: XtraMajestical
body: I think CherrylandMC is a great map and has a unique style of game play when compared with others and makes this map so fun to play. Despite as everyone probably already knows the map lasts less than 10 minutes or even less than 5 and some cases and when your trying to mess around you dont have enough time to do so and mess around. So my suggestion is that there are perhaps 4 monuments or 3 to make the game last longer and then players can have more fun perhaps. Please give feedback and maybe the word can spread? :D

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
meh. The map is great, I love it, one of my favourite maps. But the problem with 4 monuments is that the map is big enough to roam around in and have 2 monuments but adding 2 more would take up a huge amount of space making 
1. The availability to roam around harder since where would you put the monuments, its a rectangular map.
2. If it doesn't finish in the first 10 minutes defences are already created and you need "teamwork" which is pretty hard tbh in a public match you have a whole hour match.

replies.author: _Jupiter
replies.body:
I love this map <3
You're right, there's never enough time to build anything but I'm not sure where you'd add monuments. Maybe a back monument as well so that there would be three jutting out behind spawn?
There also should be some way to monitor griefing - within 5 minutes of the map starting some annoying 10 year old has almost always blown up the base.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
I don't think adding more monuments would really work on CherrylandMC, mainly because of it's size and gameplay aspect. Overall, the map plays decent at the moment, but the TNT situation could be improved.
I'll try to find ways to make the map last longer.
